details.morale: Flees at 6 hp or fewer or when Varkesh falls or retreats. Abandons loot rather than fighting to the death; does not finish off fallen PCs.
details.sourceNotes: Alchemical goods have catalogued prices and source rules but no engine-generated attack routines. Alchemist's fire: ranged touch +6, 10-ft. increment, 1d6 fire direct, 1 splash within 5 ft.; direct target takes 1d6 again next round unless extinguished. Full-round action, DC 15 Reflex to extinguish; rolling gives +2; immersion or magical extinguishing is automatic. Oil requires a full-round fuse preparation and has only a 50% ignition chance when thrown. One flask of alchemist's fire total; no free refills or bombs. Unspent NPC gear allowance is not loot.
details.tactics: Starts beside the barn, visibly pulling a stolen sack rather than hidden in ambush. Throw the single alchemist's fire at a standing opponent clear of allies, or use the bow if allies obstruct the shot. Then draw shortsword and seek a flank with a warrior; +1d6 sneak attack applies only when its conditions hold. Splash weapons cannot deal precision damage: do not add sneak attack or Bleeding Attack to alchemist's fire or oil. On a sneak attack against a living target, may inflict 1 bleed at the start of each target turn; this does not stack with itself and ends with a DC 15 Heal check or any hp healing. Evasion applies only to eligible Reflex-half attacks while in light or no armor and not helpless.
